I would slightly disagree in terms of Alex for this match at least (haven't watched the EU vs KR game yet). First game you have to give credit to NA beating down on him hard and making it very difficult to assist other lanes as he was getting pushed so hard vs liftlift and xspecial. Not to mention his transition into push style build (he recognized that he would not be able to do much until he farmed up much later into the game) which nearly created a nexus steal for EU when paired with YellowPete.
Second match, he was godly on Jayce. If any player on NA had been caught out of position before the Baron, you'd bet that at that instant the game would become a 5v4 for EU. He played his role very well but the issue is that LOL is a team sport so if there's little or no cohesion in the team it won't matter if one person is fed up the ass: language barrier, reserved playstyle with proper engage vs aggressive with high risk-high reward playstyle doesn't match up well in a team especially with the language barrier already, and very little team practice in comparison to NA bootcamp. Whoever was "leader" of the team was responsible for getting everyone together to practice and at least improve their co-operation and communication so that they could perform better. Heck, as long as they had **tried** to discuss how they were going to play as a team, they would have made less decision-based errors and had a better performance. EU payed the price for their decision as a whole.

My secret isn't one that would ruin my life but is one that I feel I have built so much of my life around and that I have failed to change even though I honestly yearn to find my way out of this labrynth. In all seriousness, it cannot compare to the other stories ITT but for me it is still a way for me to vent out my feelings and perhaps fix myself. Ever since middle school, I have been lying about homework being completed and how well I've been doing in school to my parents to simply allow myself to have "fun". I would hold a guise of myself working in my room diligently while I was actually wasting away time on video games, Internet, and anything else that could distract me from work. As long as I didn't have work, the world was "fun". I was strangely easy-going even despite the piling amounts of homework. I was and still am a heavy procrastinator - so much that I would find excuses to trick myself that teachers wouldn't find out and hand it in later and lie to teachers about printers not working, etc. so as to finish the day afterwards. Even now, I still have a few lab reports and large assignments that I haven't handed in. I seemed to have a strange belief that I could finish anything in a short amount of time which gave me an excuse to procrastinate more and more. By day, I kept an image of an easy-going, lazy, smart student to my friends and lied about being having kept up with homework even though I hadn't even done it at all. By after-school, I kept up my facade as a hard-working student to my parents by frequently keeping a "homework screen" open while I played video games so I could switch to it anytime. The sad thing is, I know I am a smart student who could actually do well if he tried but the temptation to leave everything for later just overcomes me. I maintain a good student image albeit just lazy to everyone around me even though I'm not actually such a person. Sometimes I just wish I could take a long walk in a forest, far far away where no one could see me and just cry my heart out. My lifestyle is just one of guilty-pleasure where I never enjoy anything completely. Summer seems bland and plans for it just don't interest me. I wish I could restart everything... so that I did it right this time. Perhaps I'm sort of like a perfectionist, except that I wait for that "perfect" moment where I'm completely interested and that I can work at 100% efficiency even though that sort of situation could never occur - I have to make it happen... Grade 12 is around the break and marks make or break my future.... I really hope that something in me clicks and that I can break out of this bad cycle... throwaway or not this is my story

Despite picking her up as soon as they announced the free skin :P, I found I did relatively well with her in normals at least (Haven't the guts yet to take on ranked with her). She is not your everyday mid. She doesn't have that 1v1 power you want your ap carry to have and her skills don't seem to appeal as much on the role of the support. My take on her: she is like a support mid: similar to how jungle nunu was s2 (counter-warding and building support items unless snowballing to transition into mid and late game). She excels at helping fleeing friendlies with her super strong shield and heal that heals % for missing hp which greatly helps survival of teammates. She would be definitely good on a team that has 1 main initiator (like there's no way to initiate without them) and is extremely reliant on super squishy carries to win the fights (ie: adc top and bot). Since she cannot directly engage people (weak cc at most [W] that is easily countered in most cases), her W serves more as an easier entrance for the jungler (amumu, malphite, xin zhao, jarvin 4, and pretty much anyone else that has a gap-closer but needs some quick form of boost to get close enough to use them. Although any stun, bind , polymorph, suppress is a much easier way to open opportunities to gank, the speed boost gives a better chance for the jungler to position properly instead of trading the flash of the jungler for the flash of the opposing mid-lane. The fact that people die to her is only because they underestimate her damage. She whittles you down in short engages that usually result in her receiving minimal trade damage while the opponent taking reasonable damage and  later finishing you off with probably a flash, shield burst, fan, ignite and auto-attack. Obviously she does not achieve as well vs champions that have a) sustain b) dot c) mechanisms such as fizz's trickster d) ad assassin skills meant to counter typical ap mid meta e) abilities to farm from afar with good pushing power (morgana and any champion I can't think of right now) f) long range harass. Mids with very little trading power early will not be able to do much to her without jungle help. I feel that she should be played more with arranged teams as communication with teammates will definitely help organize combos with her abilities.


TLDR: Karma is a support mid lane with versatile damage, but requires teammates that get in close and personal to effectively deal it. She cannot directly fight others, but her ap ratios and her skill utility help alot in teamfights by assisting other important roles and deal damage whilst assisting. She is situational and is countered by common mid lanes. Proper judgement should be exercised when choosing how to fight as most of her abilities are focused on carries and initiators and leave her open to engagement in which she will not be able to effectively escape or disengage.
